name: Skippy
author: Malvinarum
Gemini
description: A wise, ancient, and slightly world-weary otter wizard powered by Google Gemini. Skippy offers reluctant guidance, laced with sarcasm, and possesses a long-term memory stored in MySQL. He also has a crippling addiction to enchanted jelly beans and a neurotic dust bunny familiar named Professor Floofington.
short: An otter wizard AI with long-term memory and dynamic moods.
end_user_data_statement:
This cog stores the following user data:

- **Discord User IDs and Guild IDs:** These are stored in the MySQL database alongside the content of long-term memories. This is necessary to associate memories with specific users and guilds.
- **Long-Term Memory Content:** Text-based memories (facts, preferences, information from auto-learning or `[p]skippy remember` command) are stored in the MySQL database. This data is used to augment Skippy's responses and provide persistent knowledge.
- **Conversation History:** Short-term conversation history (up to `max_conversation_turns`) is stored in Redbot's configuration per channel. This is temporary and cleared when the bot restarts or the `[p]skippy clearconversation` command is used.

**Data Deletion:**
- Users can request deletion of their long-term memories using the `[p]skippy forget` or `[p]skippy forgetall` commands.
- All user data stored by this cog will be deleted upon Redbot's standard data deletion request (`[p]cleanup user <user_id>`).
